overall_summary: Analysis of 36 Shorts reveals that cosmic-scale scenarios (Saturn's rings, atmosphere loss, sound in space) drive peak performance, reaching up to 1,052 studio views and >64% retention. Short looping visual concepts yield dramatic re-watch rates (up to 195.54% average percentage watched), whereas rapid gravity or abstract color shifts experience severe initial drop-offs in the first 5 seconds.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' achieved 882 studio views and 64.15% average view percentage; 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' gained 1,052 studio views and 50.68% retention.
what_is_working.action: Prioritize high-stakes cosmic and global physics scenarios with immediate visual transformations.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Passed Through Saturn's Rings?' generated a 195.54% average view percentage with audience watch ratios staying above 2.74x throughout the retention curve.
what_is_working.action: Structure script endings to flow directly back into the opening sentence to trigger automatic second views.

what_to_improve.pattern: Early Retention Cliff on Abstract Concepts
what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Earth's Atmosphere Turned Neon Pink?' dropped to 15.37% relative retention by 10% progress; 'What If Earth's Gravity Tripled For 5 Seconds?' plummeted to 10.18% retention by 10% progress.
what_to_improve.action: Replace aesthetic or numerical abstract hooks with tangible, immediate physical consequences within the first 2 seconds.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Magnetic Field?' was published twice within 11 seconds on 2026-09-04, resulting in one video getting 10 views while the other got 365 views.
what_to_improve.action: Ensure strict automated scheduling guards to prevent double-posting identical titles.

retention_insights.evidence: In 'What If Earth Passed Through Saturn's Rings?', audience_watch_ratio starts at 3.62x and remains at 2.74x at 49% progress.
retention_insights.action: Design visual timelines where the payoff happens at 0:45, looping seamlessly back to 0:00.

retention_insights.evidence: In 'What If All Ocean Water Vanished for 5 Seconds?', relative retention rises from 42.6% at 10% progress to 55.9% at 49% progress.
retention_insights.action: Use 5-second countdown structure where the resolution rebuilds audience engagement near the midpoint.

retention_insights.evidence: In 'What If Earth's Atmosphere Turned to Liquid?', audience watch ratio drops from 1.1 at 1% progress down to 0.75 at 9% progress.
retention_insights.action: Show immediate scale (cities underwater/crushed) in frame 1 instead of narrative setup.

best_posting_windows.reason: Captures peak early morning discovery velocity; produced top performers 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' (1,038 views at 04:56 UTC) and 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' (701 views at 04:47 UTC).
Aligns with high-retention mid-day viewing; produced highest performing video overall 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' (880 views, 64.15% retention at 12:08 UTC).
